independent_checks.check: Let C be a designated six-vertex cover, O=V\C, D={u in O: deg_T(u)>=2}, and L=|O\D|. O is independent, so every vertex in O\D is an original degree-one vertex adjacent to C, and every vertex of D has all neighbors in C. Deleting the O\D leaves preserves a connected subtree containing C. Thus K=T[C union D] is a tree. Counting edges and vertices gives n-1=e_C+sum_D deg(u)+L and n=6+t+L, hence e_C+sum_D(deg(u)-1)=5. Since every D vertex contributes at least 1, t<=5-e_C. Conversely, a connected core obeying this budget has 5+t edges on 6+t vertices, hence is a tree; attaching the specified leaves preserves the tree and designated cover. This also covers smaller covers after padding to size six, since n>6.

For fixed n,t the leaf multiplicities are weak compositions of L=n-6-t into six nonnegative parts. Stars and bars gives binom(L+5,5)=binom(n-t-1,5). At n=30,t=0 this is binom(29,5)=118755. The source text's formula binom(n-t-2,5) is off by one (it yields 98280 at n=30,t=0), though its subsequent stated largest count is correct. Enumerating all weak compositions as the recipe says remains complete; only the displayed formula is erroneous.
independent_checks.result: complete recipe retained with corrected count formula
